answer: The canyon holds work receipts rather than names, so the pulse of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cedar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
